verdict.rationale: skills.sh ships an official CLI (`npx skills`) with a well-documented command set: add, use, list, find, update, remove, init, and lockfile restore. It also has non-interactive, CI-friendly flags and agent targeting across 70+ agents. A hands-on probe confirmed it runs keylessly and auto-switches to promptless mode when driven by a coding agent. Missing for 10: documented version pinning (lockfile restore/sync is still marked experimental) and machine-readable (e.g., JSON) output for programmatic consumers.
